title: optimization.decision
description: PAYLOAD of the `optimization.decision` envelope. Topic: metrics.optimization.decision. Emitted by the optimizer (§12 Draft/Trash/Promote brain) every tick (4h) when it decides to act on an arm/cell. Carries the decision + a mandatory plain-language + vernacular Explanation with evidence (P5 — no silent actions). A decision to mutate MUST flow through the ActionPlan path: this event references the action_plan_id it created (P4 — the optimizer never mutates directly; it proposes a plan that must be signed). Decisions are labelled confidence high|medium|low and the optimizer REFUSES 'winner' below the War-Game min-detectable threshold (§12.6 honesty). Canonical field shape from Appendix A.

scope.description: Grain the decision acts on (Appendix A: ad). arm = creative x audience-cell x destination; cell = ad set (§12.1).

platform_ref.description: The targeted entity (Appendix A: 'meta:ad:123'), form platform:entity:id.

decision.description: The Draft/Trash/Promote verdict (§12). trash = pause/retire; promote = scale/graduate/mitosis; draft = queue a new creative brief; hold = no action this tick.

rule.description: Which guardrail/rule fired (Appendix A: G2). Trash guardrails G1-G6, promote criteria, fatigue G5 (§12.3-12.5).

explanation.description: Mandatory Explanation (P5, Appendix A). Plain-EN + vernacular HI + evidence + expected effect + confidence + reversibility + undo plan. Mirrors the ActionPlan Explanation shape.

action_plan_id.description: The ActionPlan this decision created (Appendix A action_plan_id). The mutation happens ONLY when that plan is signed+executed (P4). Absent for decision=hold/draft (no mutation).

posterior.description: The Gamma-Poisson posterior summary on qualified-lead rate per Rs that drove the call (§12.1) — supports the confidence label + counterfactual replay (§14.3).

p_cpql_gt_target.description: Posterior tail prob used by G3 (§12.3).

signal_health.description: Optimizer REFUSES to grade lead-quality claims when signal health is red (§11.3 honesty). green|amber|red gates autonomy.
